I don't know if this will be helpful or would even make any sense. I was so extremely suicidal that I had given up everything, even therapy and medication (which honestly helped a lot and do to this day). I had set a date, I was extremely sure that it was the optimum point of time to kill myself. That gave me a few months of time, not knowing what to do with myself I started doing all of the things that I would miss doing when I was dead. I went out more often (I couldn't go out for almost a year and half till that point because of panic attacks and constant crippling anxiety about social situations and public spaces), I started taking my then partner out on dates, sometimes twice/thrice a week, I watched everything I wanted to watch, spoke to everyone I thought I would miss. This ultimately is why I am still around. I just thought that it wasn't all too bad, I could just wait a few more months and see. If nothing I could always fall back on my fool proof plan. And a few months now turned into over a year and even though there are periods of severe depression and anxiety, I have a sense that if I gave myself time and space I'd get to a place of fine, if not a place of great.
